newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hansol Paper sets rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Hansol Paper sets rights issue.

text.p: South Korea's Hansol Paper Co Ltd said on Thursday it would offer a 14-for-100 rights issue in December to pay back loans and raise operating funds.
The issue will increase the company's paid-in capital to 103.6 billion won from 89.04 billion.

A Hansol statement said the company planned to issue 2.91 million common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to employees. The rest would be allocated to shareholders registered as of November 26 for rights.
The issue price will be set at a 20 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for December 26 and 27, with payment due by January 3.
Hansol Paper shares closed 26,600 won, up 1,500 won, on Thursday.
